identity.operation: Normalize text with NLF2LS and without STRIPCC.
identity.condition: Input contains LF and an unrelated tab.
identity.capability: Convert LF to U+2028 while preserving the tab.
identity.consequence: This option combination is not exercised.

requirement: Normalize an LF to U+2028 with NLF2LS while preserving an unrelated control such as a tab by omitting STRIPCC.

assessment.necessity_reason: Both versions support independently selecting NLF2LS without STRIPCC. A buffer containing LF and tab then produces U+2028 and preserves the tab. The old harness's direct NLF2LS call always includes STRIPCC; its other calls do not provide an equivalent conversion.

before.requirement: With NLF2LS and without STRIPCC, convert LF to U+2028 while preserving an unrelated tab.
before.reason: The flags are distinct, and the normalizer converts LF to U+2028 while its STRIPCC guard leaves tab unchanged when that flag is absent. The harness pairs its direct NLF2LS call with STRIPCC. Its map call selects both NLF flags, which converts LF back to LF.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines NLF2LS, NLF2PS and STRIPCC as distinct option bits.
The map path passes its selected options through decomposition and reencoding to the normalizer.

after.requirement: With NLF2LS and without STRIPCC, convert LF to U+2028 while preserving an unrelated tab.
after.reason: The changed normalizer retains the LF conversion and preserves tab when STRIPCC is absent. The same fixed harness still pairs direct NLF2LS with STRIPCC; its map call with both NLF flags yields LF instead of U+2028.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the independently selectable option bits.
The map path passes its selected options through decomposition and reencoding to the normalizer.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Shows the input guards; a finite native UTF-32 buffer containing LF, tab and a final zero word can pass them.

assessment.comparison_reason: The same LF conversion with tab preservation is required on both sides. The same fixed option combinations prevent the old harness from reaching it on both sides.

necessity_evidence.reason: The old harness cannot exercise the supported NLF2LS option without STRIPCC. This is the same coverage gap before and after the source change, so it is preexisting.
necessity_evidence.finite_witness: A 12-byte input containing three native UTF-32 words [U+000A, U+0009, U+0000] passes the harness guards. Normalizing those words with NLF2LS alone would produce [U+2028, U+0009, U+0000]. The harness never makes that option choice.

scope_contract.reason: UTF-32 normalization and its options are part of the entry's primary operations. Both source versions define NLF2LS and STRIPCC as separate bits and support the same tuple.

evidence.dependency_reason: Defines NLF2LS and STRIPCC as independently selectable options.

feasible_trigger.reason: LF and tab are valid, finite UTF-32 input words. The source converts LF to U+2028 with NLF2LS alone and preserves tab when STRIPCC is absent; the proposed input passes the harness size and terminator guards.

evidence.dependency_reason: Establishes that NLF2LS can be selected without STRIPCC.
Allocates and fills the UTF-32 buffer for a 12-byte input.

observable_consequence.reason: The supported LF-to-U+2028 conversion with tab preserved is unreachable through the harness's fixed direct normalization choices: its NLF2LS-only call also enables STRIPCC, which changes tab to space.

alternatives_ruled_out.reason: The complete entry has no other NLF2LS-only call. Its map call selects both NLF flags, which converts LF to LF; the remaining map calls and normalization wrappers do not select NLF2LS. Supplying an existing U+2028 would not exercise conversion of LF.

evidence.dependency_reason: Shows that map passes the harness's selected flags through reencoding.
Reencoding invokes the same normalizer with those flags.
Shows the fixed options used by the normalization wrappers called by the harness.

identity_preserved.reason: The same operation, LF-and-tab condition, capability, and fixed harness blocker apply before and after. The changed lines affect STRIPCC handling, but neither version permits this harness to select NLF2LS without STRIPCC.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Establishes the map and wrapper option routes relevant to equivalence.

harness_evidence.dependency_reason: Defines the input guards for the finite witness.

coverage_witness.supported_behavior: Normalize LF to U+2028 while preserving an unrelated tab by selecting NLF2LS without STRIPCC.
coverage_witness.required_setup: An input containing LF and tab, with NLF2LS enabled and STRIPCC disabled.
coverage_witness.actual_target_setup: Every direct NLF2LS normalization call enables STRIPCC; the map call enables both NLF flags.
coverage_witness.blocked_behavior: No harness call converts the input LF to U+2028 while preserving its tab.
coverage_witness.equivalent_routes: None in the complete entry: both NLF flags yield LF, and calls without NLF2LS do not perform the requested LF conversion.
